Method of Attack: Information stealing of browser history, saved browser credentials, browser cookies, FileZilla credentials, Discord credentials, Steam credentials
Clipboard hijacking (clipper) to swap cryptocurrency addresses copied to clipboard with attacker-controlled addresses
Sending stolen data to attacker via Telegram
Attack Vector: YouTube videos promoting fake bitcoin generator tool with download link to Setup.exe Trojan installer
Indicators of Compromise: Setup.exe file downloaded from links in YouTube video descriptions
Telegram traffic used to exfiltrate stolen data
Links to https://freebitco.in site in video descriptions
